_note1: Template for webpages.json. Copy to webpages.json and adjust.
_note3: Comments must also follow the JSON format.
_note4: The key STOP causes all following keys to be ignored. Useful for test runs.
_note5: Below are some examples of possible entries. See 'DOCUMENTATION.md' for more details.
_short_form: Short name -> URL. The short name is also the name of the data folder (allowed: letters, digits, dot, underscore, hyphen).
_long_form: Object with 'url'. Equivalent to the short form if only 'url' is given.
_accept_status: Use the content even if the server answers with one of these HTTP error codes (only for servers known to send a wrong status code).
_ignore: Lines left out when comparing, per section (text, images, links). Pattern = case-insensitive substring; prefix 're:' = regular expression.
_login_env: With HTTP Basic login. The password is stored in an environment variable (recommended).
_login_wordpress: With the WordPress login form. 'login_url' is optional (default: <site>/wp-login.php).
_login_plain: With HTTP Basic login, password directly in the file (only if the file is protected; never commit it to Git).
